items.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
items.snippet: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

items.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
items.snippet: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.
